cases.why: eleven concepts missed; a sitting is 4 so the run stays finishable
missed counts double skipped, so the heaviest four are served
'Taught first, then tested again' must hold for a learner who had already read the lesson, not only at first contact
repairedAt is stamped so the next sitting picks up rather than repeating
a mock reorders what is offered and creates no mastery evidence

control.question: is the missing re-teach caused by examMisses being invisible to lessonNeedsReteach?
control.method: same concept, same lessonsRead, same examMiss, plus ONE wrong conceptAttempt after readAt
control.conclusion: confirmed — the lesson returns only when conceptAttempts carries the failure; a mock miss alone never triggers it
